sources.reading_scope: Complete four-page Chinese PDF visually read. Physical p1 preamble and start of purpose; p2 purpose and ministry leadership; p3 Ten-Year Framework and climate dialogue; p4 continuation, no-international-law-obligations clause and signature dates. sources.establishes: The 2009 baseline already provides recurring ministerial and leader-representative consultations, ministry participation and both existing and additional cooperation mechanisms.

No complete operational meeting calendar or prior sectoral action plans obtained.
